career_ladder.note: Assistant Audit Officer (AAO) and Assistant Accounts Officer (AAO) are the premier Group 'B' Gazetted (Non-Ministerial) posts recruited through the SSC CGL examination under the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG / IA&AD). Promotion from AAO to Audit Officer / Accounts Officer (AO) requires passing the Subordinate Audit/Accounts Service (SAS) examination and completing mandatory residency.

exam_scheme.note: The examination is conducted as part of the Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination by SSC. Candidates must clear Tier I (computer-based objective screening, 200 marks) to qualify for Tier II. In Tier II, all candidates appear for Paper I (Mathematical Abilities, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, and Computer Knowledge Module + DEST typing test). For AAO posts, an additional specialized Paper III (General Studies — Finance and Economics, 100 questions, 200 marks) was traditionally required; in cycles where AAO posts are notified, final merit incorporates Paper I and Paper III scores.

financial_package.note: Assistant Audit Officer and Assistant Accounts Officer are the highest-paying posts in SSC CGL, placed in Pay Level 8 (₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100) under the 7th CPC. They are the only Group 'B' Gazetted positions offered through the examination.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian Employees), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 8 entry basic pay of ₹47,600 with 58% DA (₹27,608), HRA (10% to 30% depending on city classification X/Y/Z), Transport Allowance (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 + DA on TA), and deducting 10% NPS contribution.
official_perks: Group 'B' Gazetted Officer status under the Comptroller & Auditor General of India
Central Government Employees Group Insurance Scheme (CGEGIS)
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) medical coverage for officer and family
Daily Allowance and Travelling Allowance (TA/DA) for field audit tours across government departments and PSUs
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Annual Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
Government residential quarters allocation through Directorate of Estates / CAG pool

competition_benchmarks.note: Vacancies for Assistant Audit Officer (A01) and Assistant Accounts Officer (A02) in the Indian Audit and Accounts Department under CAG. In CGLE 2024, no AAO vacancies were requisitioned by CAG in the initial notification. In CGLE 2023, 225 vacancies were finalized for AAO (Audit). In CGLE 2022, a bumper recruitment of 1,462 vacancies (1,260 Audit + 202 Accounts) was conducted.
